description: What's leaving now from the MTR stations, bus stops and green minibus stops around a place in Hong Kong, nearest first: each route and direction once (at its nearest stop), where it's heading and the minutes until its next two departures, live from the operators. No destination needed: for "when's my bus" or "what leaves near here". Trams, ferries and Light Rail aren't included; for a trip from A to B use plan_trip.

language.description: Language for place and line names: en, zh-HK (Traditional Chinese), zh-CN (Simplified), ja, ko

place.description: Where: a place name, address or "lat,lon" (e.g. "Mong Kok", "Hotel Icon", "22.3016,114.1772")

name: nearby_departures

also.description: Other candidates when the match is loose

kind.description: mtr, bus, ferry, restaurant, hotel, attraction, address…

note.description: Set when the match is loose: check it's the place meant

stops.description: Nearest first, within about 400 m (stations about 750 m). Each route and direction appears once, at its nearest stop

minutes.description: Minutes until the next departures, soonest first; 0 = due now

route.description: Bus or minibus number, or the MTR line ("Tsuen Wan")

scheduled.description: true: the first time is the timetable's, not live

towards.description: Where it heads (a minibus's from its route and direction; absent where unknown)

title: Live departures near a place in Hong Kong
